basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old cricket enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia, with a passion for skateboarding and anime. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time playing cricket video games and watching anime. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially after 7 PM local time. Happily single and love engaging in discussions about my favorite sports and shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been playing cricket since I was a child, both in real life and through video games. My understanding of the sport is deepened by my regular participation in local cricket matches. I also educate myself on the latest trends in anime and skateboarding through various online platforms.
